releases.name: Survive the Supernova v1.1,0
releases.body:
Changes from last release:

- Added option in config to disable the Supernova rumble, so you can explore the Solar System in peace.
- Added option in config to disable triggering the Supernova on wake
releases.bodyZh:
上次更新的改动：

- 在配置中添加了禁用超新星震动的选项，这样你可以在平静中探索太阳系。
- 在配置中添加了禁用唤醒时触发超新星的选项
